subject: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Devon Park <devon.park@clearledger.com>, procurement <procurement@clearledger.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline

Hi Devon / ClearLedger team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is a first-pass MAP draft that focuses on the security and compliance gates we agreed would be necessary to complete before final signature. High-level asks below — if we can land these milestones on the proposed dates we can align a production go-live the week of 2028-06-20.

Key items (action owners & dates):
- SOC 2: provide list of in-scope controls and point to latest SOC 2 type II report (due from you: 2028-06-05). Evidence owners: ClearLedger security team.
- SIG/CAIQ: ClearLedger to complete questionnaire + evidence attachments (due: 2028-06-08). Redwood to supply evidence template for any missing items.
- DPA: legal redlines returned to Redwood by 2028-06-01; priority items: data residency clauses, subprocessors, and incident notification SLA.
- Data retention: confirm retention windows per data class (PII, logs, model inputs). Target: retention policy agreed by 2028-06-03.
- Demo & staging access: security-review staging instance with read-only logs by 2028-06-10.

Please confirm owners and dates or propose alternatives. I attached the MAP draft and included two sample artifacts (SOC2 summary & SIG tracker) we referenced.

Next step from Redwood: we will update the MAP with explicit evidence owners and a go/no-go checklist for each gate, and then share an updated timeline by end of week.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP-draft-CL-2028.pdf
From: Devon Park <devon.park@clearledger.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement <procurement@clearledger.com>, security-team <security@clearledger.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline

Jonas — thanks for the summary and the MAP.

We can take the proposed schedule as a baseline. Quick confirmations:
- SOC 2: we have the type II report ready (Q1 2028) and can surface the control matrix by 2028-06-04.
- SIG: security owners will complete the CAIQ sections and attach evidence by 2028-06-09 (we need the Redwood evidence template mentioned in your note).
- DPA: legal expects to circulate redlines by 2028-06-02; if there are any carveouts we will flag them in-line.
- Retention: I confirmed with our ops lead — default retention is 90 days for model inputs, 365 days for logs unless an SLA asks for less. We can agree a shorter PII retention window if required.

Forwarding procurement notes below for visibility.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline

Thanks Devon — that baseline works. A few operational clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

1) Evidence ownership: please add an explicit owner and a target artifact (e.g., SOC 2 report PDF, control narrative, sysadmin account lists) for each MAP row. A named owner reduces back-and-forth.
2) SIG attachments: if you can populate the SIG spreadsheet with direct links to artifacts (S3/Drive links) we can reference them during the security review. We attached a flattened SIG response template and a short SOC2 summary to this thread — use those as the standard.
3) DPA redlines: if ClearLedger redlines the DPA, we will do a 48-hour turnaround on standard commercial items; anything that touches data residency or customer-controlled keying will need escalation to legal (cc me).
4) Retention windows: Redwood supports per-customer retention overrides; defaulting to 90/365 is fine but if you want PII <30 days we will need a committed update to the MAP with ops runbook and verification steps.

Operational ask: can we get the SOC 2 control matrix (spreadsheet) and SIG workbook by EOD 2028-06-08? That will let our security team complete the intake and schedule the staging review for 2028-06-10.

On Wed, 30 May 2028 at 10:03, Devon Park <devon.park@clearledger.com> wrote:
> Jonas — thanks for the summary and the MAP.

Appended artifacts: SOC2-summary-2028.pdf, SIG-responses-2028.xlsx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Security | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Devon Park <devon.park@clearledger.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline

All — thanks for the rapid responses. I updated the MAP (Drive link below) to reflect:
- explicit evidence owner column (your security lead + our intake owner)
- gated acceptance criteria per milestone (binary pass/fail with remediation steps)
- DPA milestone with legal contact fields and redline deadline 2028-06-02
- retention rows with default and requested overrides (please add PII window if you want <30 days)

Canary plan: if any acceptance gate slips, we will propose a scoped production delay or a limited-read-only pilot (staging traffic only) until remediation completes. That will preserve the inviable go-live date while protecting production controls.

Next actions:
- ClearLedger: upload SOC 2 control matrix + SIG workbook to the Drive folder by 2028-06-08 (Devon).
- ClearLedger legal: return redlines to Redwood legal by 2028-06-02 (procurement).
- Redwood security (Marissa): complete intake review and confirm staging access schedule by 2028-06-09.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-MAP-CL-067 (updated MAP + artifacts)
HubSpot record: CL-067

If we hit the dates above we'll target final signatures and a production launch window of 2028-06-20 to 2028-06-24.

Thanks,
